tonight.headline: 52% — Golden is in, Walker is out, Tuten did not practise
body: Bad news first. Tuten did not practise Wednesday (Schefter, 21:13Z), and Likely is questionable with a groin — limited Wednesday, a good sign per Rotoworld, but there is no tight end behind him. Jacobs is unlikely tonight (LaFleur). You are 3-8.

The good news is yours: Golden is now in the lineup, Kansas City ruled out Kenneth Walker III for Thursday, and JuiceJam pulled him at 12:44 CDMX. ESPN has it 130.6 to 125.7, 52%. The lineup is the projection lineup. Golden and the Rams D/ST play at 19:00 tonight.
